text:
Alex: Quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/21477 needs merge before tomorrow's 09:00 deploy window. Locally green, CI failing on two flaky tests intermittently. Need eyes and an approval. @Marta @TJ

CI-bot: build #53214 — failed on integ/kvcache/shard9 (timeout) and ui/snapshot-macos (image mismatch). Logs: `Shard9: Timeout after 600s`; `macos-snap: diff in renderer.png +2px` Link: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/53214

Marta: On it, can look now. Which commit? Alex, can you paste the failing test log snippet?

Alex: commit 7b3f4a1 — small kv-prefetch tweak. Log snippet:
```
ERROR: TestKvShard9::test_eviction_race
AssertionError: expected evict_count 3 != 2
Stack: .../kv/evict.cc:243
```
Also snapshot diff shows font subpixel shift on macos.

TJ: I can repro the macos snapshot locally on my M1. Looks like skia raster differences from font version. For kvcache, maybe timing-sensitive. Sam, did we change any timers in the prefetch PR?

Sam: I adjusted prefetch window earlier but added a safety check. Quick idea: add an extra sleep(20ms) in test to stabilize? Not ideal. Prefer to run targeted reruns and decide.

Alex: I'd prefer to avoid test change. Can we rerun only the failing shards and see flake rate? If 1/10, merge with note; if >3/10, bisect.

Lin: If we merge, we need one more reviewer approval. I'm OOO starting 17:00 PST. Can someone hold the merge if it causes fallout?

Marta: I'll run targeted reruns now:
`/ci rerun --shards=shard9,macos-snapshot --pr=21477 --attempts=5`

CI-bot: Rerun queued. Results:
attempt 1: shard9 PASS, macos-snapshot FAIL (diff)
attempt 2: shard9 FAIL (timeout), macos-snapshot PASS
attempt 3: both PASS
attempt 4: shard9 PASS, macos-snapshot PASS
attempt 5: shard9 PASS, macos-snapshot FAIL

Marta: Flakiness observed: shard9 ~20% timeout, macos-snapshot ~40% image delta in these runs.

TJ: Given snapshot inconsistency, I'd open a follow-up to pin font in test infra. For this PR, I recommend: 1) do a snapshot-bless candidate? 2) or require 1 more stable pass. Sam, can we add a short guard to prefetch to reduce timing sensitivity?

Sam: I can try a micro-fix (use atomic increment scheduling) and push to the PR branch; will run through CI. If it stabilizes, merge.

Alex: Thanks. Action items: Sam to push micro-fix (in progress), Marta to monitor reruns, TJ to open infra ticket for mac font pinning, Lin to hold final merge approval if any more fails during merge window. I'll update PR description with the flaky-run summary.

Lin: FYI I'm okay with merging after Sam's fix and 3 consecutive successful targeted runs. :+1:

Alex: Done — updated PR and added summary and rerun logs. Sam will ping when fix is up.

Sam: Pushed fix at 7b3f4a2 and kicked off targeted runs. Will update in this thread.

CI-bot: Rerun results for 7b3f4a2: attempts 1-3 all PASS.

Sam: All green on attempts 1-3. Requesting approval.

TJ: Reviewed, LGTM. :shipit:

Lin: Approving remotely. Go ahead Alex.

Alex: Merged into main at 4360008250. Thanks all.
